title: California Insurance Code Section 10166 (no agreement may waive the standard nonforfeiture law)
updateCadence: Amended only by legislation. The section credit on the official host at the time of access read Added by Stats. 1943, Ch. 955.
claims: Section 10166 provides that no agreement between the insurer and the policyholder or applicant for insurance contrary to Article 3a shall be held to waive any of the provisions of the article.
